notes: One JSON object per line. Frames are decimated to trace_hz; links and beliefs are deltas against the previous state, so a reader holds the last value it saw; telemetry is per drone id at 1 Hz; log records are whatever the brains wrote through host->log, at full rate and in drone id order, with drone -1 meaning the simulator itself; the last line is the run report. Nothing before the report line is a wall-clock reading, so two traces of one scenario and brain are byte identical up to it.
